QF.id: SIA Social Stock Exchange Introduction and Instruments_15

question.text: A social enterprise must be engaged in one of the eligible activities specified under which regulation of the SEBI ICDR Regulations, 2018, to raise funds on the SSE?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per p.69 of the workbook, ZCZPs 'shall be issued only for a specific project or activity that are listed under regulation 292E of the SEBI (ICDR) Regulations'. Regulation 292E enumerates the eligible activities for SSE participation. The Trap: Option A (292B) covers definitions of terms. Option C (292I) covers ZCZP issuance rules. Option D (292J) covers ZCZP eligibility criteria for the issuer — a related but distinct regulation. Note: p.16 lists 18 eligibility activities in this workbook, so any explanation that quotes a specific count should reference the workbook's own figure rather than legacy counts.
